create_class_griffin: create a Griffin language model instance with a config, gradient checkpointing, device, and dtype
run_griffin_forward: run the Griffin model forward pass with tokens, segment positions, cache, and optional logits/cache returns
build_griffin_cache: build an empty inference cache for the Griffin model with batch size and dtype
reset_griffin_parameters: reset all parameters of the Griffin model including embedder, blocks, and final norm
summarize_griffin_model: summarize the Griffin model architecture with residual blocks, embedder, and RMSNorm
